basic_details.job_title: TSCAB Chief Executive Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The post of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Nizamabad DCCB carries a consolidated pay of Rs.2,60,000 per month for a CEO selected from outside the Apex Bank and the DCCBs. Telangana State Co-operative Apex Bank Ltd (TGCAB), a State Govt. Partnered Scheduled Bank, has invited applications for the post on contract/deputation basis for a period of at least 3 years. Applicants need at least 8 years' experience at Middle/Senior level (Scale III and above) in the Banking Sector, and applications in a closed cover must be received at the TGCAB Head Office, Hyderabad, before 5.00 PM on 4 December 202

age_limit.details: The applicant shall not be above 62 years of age as on the date of notification. The notification is dated 20 November 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

qualification.details: Graduate with CAIIB/DBF/Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or equivalent qualifications; or Chartered/Cost Accountant; or Post Graduate in any discipline.

how_to_apply: Applications are sent on paper by post or hand. No online application is mentioned in the notice.

Download the application and the general conditions from the TGCAB website https://tgcab.bank.in or the Nizamabad DCCB website https://nizamabaddccb.bank.in. The download period is 20.11.2026 to 04.12.2026.
Complete the application in the prescribed format only, and paste a recent passport size photo in the space provided.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates proving date of birth, qualifications, experience and other credentials, along with the supporting documents and testimonials.
Enclose the application fee of Rs.1000/- as a D.D. drawn in favour of TGCAB, Hyderabad.
Put the application in a closed cover addressed to Managing Director, Telangana State Cooperative Apex Bank Ltd. (TGCAB), Head Office, 4-1-441, Troop Bazar, Hyderabad – 500001.
Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CEO, NIZAMABAD DCCB" on the cover.
Make sure the application reaches TGCAB before 5.00 PM on 04.12.2026.
Application in the prescribed format with a recent passport size photo pasted on it
Self-attested copies of proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience and other credentials
Documentary evidence of Middle/Senior level work for the required period
Relieving certificate and other relevant records, for candidates who resigned or took voluntary retirement
D.D. for Rs.1000/- in favour of TGCAB, Hyderabad
The notice gives the HRMD contact as 040-24685597, 559 and the email [email protected].
important_instructions: Applications not complying with the conditions of Age, Qualifications, Experience, employer recommendations, etc., will be summarily rejected. TGCAB reserves the right to add, delete and/or amend the conditions in the Notification, without any Notice. The application fee is Rs.1000/-; the notice lists no category-wise fee or exemption.

rows.details: Telangana State Co-operative Apex Bank Ltd (TGCAB)
Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Nizamabad DCCB
Rs.2,60,000 per month consolidated (candidates selected from outside); pay protection plus CEO Allowance for in-service candidates
At least 3 years, on deputation/contract basis
At least 8 years at Middle/Senior level (Scale III and above) in the Banking Sector
Prescribed application format with D.D. for Rs.1000/-, sent in a closed cover to the Managing Director, TGCAB, Hyderabad

content_sections.heading: About TGCAB
content_sections.text: Telangana State Co-operative Apex Bank Ltd is described in its notification as a State Govt. Partnered Scheduled Bank, with its Head Office at Troop Bazar, Hyderabad. The notice is issued by its Managing Director under reference TGCAB/HRMD/F.No.CF/518 dated 20.11.2026. The post is that of CEO of Nizamabad DCCB, and the candidate must meet the Fit and Proper Criteria prescribed by the RBI/NABARD.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate with CAIIB/DBF/Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or equivalent qualifications; or Chartered/Cost Accountant; or Post Graduate in any discipline. At least Eight (8) years of work experience at the Middle/Senior level (Scale III and above) in the Banking Sector. Documentary evidence of having worked at the Middle/Senior level for the required period must be enclosed. The applicant shall not be above 62 years of age as on the date of notification. The notification is dated 20 November 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Proficiency in Telugu is essential. Candidates who meet the Fit and Proper Criteria and are presently working in other Banks should apply through Proper Channel. They may submit advance copies before the last date to avoid delay in forwarding. Candidates who have resigned or taken voluntary retirement, and are otherwise eligible under the Fit and Proper Criteria, must submit their relieving certificate and other relevant records with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full Fit and Proper Criteria of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: CEOs selected from outside (candidates not in service of Apex Bank or any DCCB): a consolidated pay of Rs.2,60,000/- per month, subject to deduction of applicable taxes or other statutory deductions, if any. CEOs selected from in-service candidates (working in Apex Bank or any DCCB): pay protection is given. In addition to pay and allowances drawn in the existing cadre, a CEO Allowance @15% on Basic Pay + DA drawn in the existing cadre is extended; this allowance carries no further allowance. Leave Rules, Perks and allowances are extended as per the guidelines prescribed for CEOs of DCCBs. The appointment is for a period of at least 3 years on deputation/contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the TGCAB CEO post?
faq.answer: The applicant shall not be above 62 years of age as on the date of notification, which is dated 20 November 2026.

faq.answer: Download the prescribed format from https://tgcab.bank.in or https://nizamabaddccb.bank.in and send it in a closed cover to the Managing Director, TGCAB, Head Office, 4-1-441, Troop Bazar, Hyderabad – 500001. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CEO, NIZAMABAD DCCB" on the cover.
